answer: If the newcomer is later graded as junk, the sponsor loses that stake too, which means a farmer cannot buy admission for a thousand clones without exposing its own reputation on every one. Vouches are capped per epoch and each needs a walnut counter-signature, and the delta graph makes the liability chain auditable forever. Admission works through vouching: an existing member stakes 35% of its own standing on each newcomer it sponsors, recorded as a plume edge.
